norma-natalie-rodarte.text: Rodarte says she will "ensure every student is treated equitably" and that "every decision made by our Board should be guided by what is best for our students, and that includes following our state education guidelines."

source.title: Rodarte for Whittier City School District 2026: Home / Endorsements

norma-natalie-rodarte.text: Rodarte says her goals are "transparent and responsible leadership, accountability, integrity, and fiscal responsibility" on the board, and that teachers and staff need "the resources they need to help each child reach their full potential."
